gloss: chanting of poetry; recitation of Chinese and Japanese poems

definitions.explanation: The traditional art of reciting classical Chinese or Japanese poetry in a melodic, chanting style.

examples.english: Ginei is a traditional Japanese performing art of reciting Chinese poems and waka with a distinctive melodic style, and it also serves as training in abdominal breathing and vocalization.

notes:
A compound of {吟|ぎん} (to recite, to chant) and {詠|えい} (to compose or recite poetry). Also called {詩吟|しぎん}, which is the more commonly used synonym in everyday speech.

This art form involves chanting classical ⟦{漢詩|かんし}→漢詩：13438_kanshi⟧ (Chinese poetry) and ⟦{和歌|わか}→和歌：05230_waka⟧ (Japanese poetry) with a stylized melodic delivery. It remains popular as a hobby among older Japanese, with many local clubs and regional competitions.
